algorithm_candidate.name: deterministic identity-bound observation with delta evidence frontier
treatment_only_changes: one complete observation before the first model request
one complete observation after every 16 completed shell operations
one complete observation before replay when the construction state changed since the latest observation
delta-ledger feedback injected into the same continuous model session

E-SCHEDULED.difference_from_control: deterministic observation schedule and evidence deltas; no additional callable tool

cadence_derivation.rule: round the consumed-14 natural interval once to a power-of-two engineering cadence; do not tune on qualification outcomes

case_selection.prior_evidence: candidate noncompletion, compatibility regression, and late correction of environment identity
one historical B-FSR global goal check across 132 pre-candidate shell actions and a candidate only at request 111
a successful historical path temporarily regressed from 1 to 6 missing imports before reaching zero
a long 61-to-26-to-2-to-2-to-2-to-2-to-0 compatibility path and one optional-ledger episode with zero tool calls

claim_boundary.allowed: mechanism qualification and directional evidence on consumed design cases
forbidden: a deterministic paired counterfactual from provider seeds

comparison_invariants: same pinned DeepSeek model, DeepInfra provider, Docker image, public goal, clean replay, minimal integrity foundation, and safety caps
same continuous Agent session and unrestricted shell operation space
the Official evaluator is unavailable until model generation terminates
each episode has a fresh construction container and episode-local package cache
no package mapping, action ranking, hard monotonic rule, rollback, container checkpoint, or cross-case memory
tokens, time, network, disk, and memory are measured outcomes rather than optimization cutoffs

design.provider_seed_interpretation: logged randomization covariate; determinism is not assumed
design.selection_policy: all repositories were consumed before treatment design; cases were selected for complementary historical observation strata without treatment outcomes

primary: generation candidate formed and clean-replay certified
secondary: model requests and shell actions before first certified candidate
input, output, reasoning, and total tokens
network, disk, and peak memory when directly measurable
treatment_mechanism: scheduled trigger count and schedule compliance
initial, stagnant, improved, regressed, and mixed transitions
raw finding count and unique obligation count
evidence injection into the same model session

promotion_rule.ambiguous: mechanism acceptance passes but directional criteria do not; retain the version unchanged and run a broader consumed-case study before deciding
promotion_rule.negative: mechanism acceptance fails, Official Pass count is lower than B-FSR, or more than one paired treatment-only loss occurs; do not expose frozen Dev cases
positive_directional_signal: E-SCHEDULED Official Pass count is at least B-FSR
no more than one paired treatment-only loss
at least one paired treatment-only win, or a preregistered success-conditional efficiency improvement
promotion_rule.scope: promotion to frozen Dev evaluation, never a paper-level effect claim

stopping_and_retry_policy.infrastructure_failure: mark censored; any exact-identity retry requires a pre-execution amendment retaining the failed attempt
stopping_and_retry_policy.model_or_algorithm_failure: record as an outcome and continue the frozen schedule
